panels.title: Key values
panels.description: Latest value of a few benchmarks, from each provider.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS "time", symbol || ' · ' || provider AS metric, value
  FROM v_latest_observation
 WHERE symbol IN ('BTC/USD', 'EUR/USD', 'XAU/USD', 'ESTR', 'SOFR', 'US10Y', 'SPY')
   AND observation_type IN ('price', 'nav', 'rate', 'yield', 'index_level')
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Relative performance
panels.description: Change since the first value in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at AS "time",
       symbol || ' · ' || provider AS metric,
       (value / first_value(value) OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol, provider ORDER BY observed_at) - 1) * 100 AS value
  FROM v_observation
 WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
   AND symbol IN (${instrument:sqlstring}) AND observation_type IN ('price', 'nav', 'rate', 'yield', 'index_level')
 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest values
panels.description: Values from different providers are listed separately.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT symbol AS "Symbol",
       instrument_name AS "Name",
       provider AS "Provider",
       value AS "Value",
       coalesce(currency, unit) AS "Unit",
       quote_kind AS "Kind",
       freshness AS "Freshness",
       observed_at AS "Observed",
       age_seconds AS "Age"
  FROM v_latest_observation
 WHERE observation_type IN ('price', 'nav', 'rate', 'yield', 'index_level')
 ORDER BY symbol, provider

panels.title: Data freshness
panels.description: Age of the newest value per provider and kind of data. Daily and weekend data is up to a few days old by design.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT provider AS "Provider",
       asset_type || ' ' || observation_type AS "Data",
       series AS "Series",
       last_observed_at AS "Latest value at",
       last_ingested_at AS "Collected at",
       age_seconds AS "Age"
  FROM v_data_freshness
 WHERE true
 ORDER BY provider, asset_type, observation_type
